text: API-P6-005 answers the JSON catalog of a template version when Accept is application/json and the binary body otherwise, and the set read API-P6-003 takes treatmentType and productGroup as additional query filters; both are additive within major version 1
why: The screens need the fields of a version and its merge codes to join a merged value to its catalog row, and TSD P6 v2 appendix T-A documents the binary body and a query without those filters
read: TSD P6 Communications v2 T-A.1 and T-A.2; legacy RWB-E2-017 sections 4, 12 and 13
confirm: Solution architect and the template catalog owner accept the two additive changes in the published API document
impact: Without them the review screen has no catalog answer and the set read filters on the client

text: The locked attribute of a merge field is carried as a column of merge_field added by RWB-P6-E1046-CON and read by this story; until that column exists the value comes from the catalog fixture
why: Legacy BR3 and section 3 make the overridable or locked mark of a merge field catalog data, and TSD P6 v2 T3.1 names no such column
read: TSD P6 Communications v2 T3.1 merge_field; legacy RWB-E2-017 sections 3 and 8
confirm: Database owner accepts the column in the catalog contract
impact: AC4 cannot prove a locked value read only until the column exists

text: The set of a treatment type and product group is answered by the widened API-P6-003 as a TemplateSetPage, one item per document type with the template code, the version in force, the Legal approval and the signature basis
why: The legacy screen shows the set with the current approved version of each template, and no source fixes the shape of that answer
read: legacy RWB-E2-017 section 4; FSD P6 Communications v3 A2.7
confirm: Screen team accepts the shape with the catalog owner
impact: The panel shape changes if the owner answers a different page

text: The rows that map a treatment type and a product group to document types and template codes are rwb-case reference data reached through RWB-P3-E1043-CON, and their field shape is taken from the contract when it is published
why: The legacy precondition calls the set reference data of Legal and the default ruling puts reference data with rwb-case (DP-07), but no source read gives the row shape
read: Template and Rules v1 section R3 default rulings and DP-07; legacy RWB-E2-017 section 3
confirm: P3 owner publishes the set rows in the reference-data contract
impact: The set read cannot be built without a documented row shape

text: The dependencies that DP-03, DP-07 and DP-19 add (RWB-PLT-E1027-CON, RWB-PLT-E1043-CON with RWB-P3-E1043-CON, and RWB-PLT-N001-CON) stay out of the four dependency columns of this story, which the plan fixed at None, RWB-P5-E2017-CON, None and None; the build runs against the platform release train and the published P3 and P5 fakes
why: Template and Rules R5.4 limits the build column to H and the plan row for this story carries no H, so the platform contracts cannot be written there
read: Template and Rules v1 sections R5.4 and R5.5; the plan row of RWB-P6-E2017-APP
confirm: Delivery lead accepts the platform contracts as release-train dependencies
impact: A missing platform contract is not visible in the dependency map of this story

text: DP-08 is not in the pattern set of this story, so the authorise answer is a REST read of rwb-access behind the platform guard and a fake in test, and no guard library work is added here
why: The plan row lists DP01, DP03, DP07, DP11, DP13 and DP19 only, while both reads declare a Documents right
read: Template and Rules v1 section R5.5 DP-08; the plan row of RWB-P6-E2017-APP
confirm: P4 owner accepts the guard as a platform library
impact: The right check is proved against a fake rather than against the guard itself

text: The release date stays 31 December 2026 and is marked tentative, and the story is Draft (realignment v1) because no approval of the realigned story is recorded
why: Decision U7 and rule 10 keep every date unchanged and tentative, and the realignment run records no human approval
read: Template and Rules v1 sections R1 U7 and R9; AGENTS.md rules 9 and 10
confirm: Delivery lead confirms the release on the plan
impact: None on the content; the status moves to Approved only on a recorded approval

text: The text of MSG-P4-003, MSG-P5-010, MSG-P6-003 and of the 403 refusal of the two reads is not in the sources read and carries the placeholder; no wording is invented
why: The legacy story and the P6 extracts carry MSG-P4-002, MSG-P5-002, MSG-P5-011 to MSG-P5-014, MSG-GEN-001, MSG-GEN-004, MSG-GEN-006 and MSG-P7-003 only
read: legacy RWB-E2-017 section 14; FSD P6 Communications v3 A2.1.3.1 and A2.7.3.1
confirm: Message catalog owner supplies the five texts
impact: The screen shows the placeholder text until the catalog is issued
